def print_deprecation_message(old_command: str, deprecation_date: datetime,
    new_command: Optional[str]=None) ->None:
    message = f'DEPRECATED: this command (`{old_command}`) has been DEPRECATED'
    if new_command:
        message += f' and replaced by `{new_command}`'
    message += f' and will be removed on or after {deprecation_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")}'
    click.secho(message, fg='yellow')
